# Losing the delimiters between statements does not only cost positions,
# it costs the check itself: a file parsed with the wrong delimiters has
# no actions in it at all, so nothing is left to type check and a real
# mistake goes unreported.
#
# Here Delims is set on the declaration and ParseFS runs in a function,
# so the delimiters have to survive between the two for [[.Missing]] to
# be seen as an action.

! check-templates
stderr 'index\.gohtml:1:3: executing "index\.gohtml" at <\.Missing>: field or method Missing not found on example\.com/app\.Page'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/app

go 1.25.0
-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"embed"
	"fmt"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var source embed.FS

var templates = template.New("app").Delims("[[", "]]")

func setup() {
	template.Must(templates.ParseFS(source, "*"))
}

type Page struct {
	Title string
}

func render() {
	_ = templates.ExecuteTemplate(io.Discard, "index.gohtml", Page{Title: "Home"})
}

var _ = fmt.Sprint

-- index.gohtml --
[[.Missing]]
